title: Your Wedding Cake Orders, Step by Step: Enquiry to Delivered

sections.label: 1 - A COUPLE ENQUIRES
sections.note: Every enquiry lands in Monday on its own, and the couple hears back right away.

sections.label: 2 - CONSULTATION: TASTING, DESIGN, DEPOSIT
sections.note: Your consultations in Monday: Zapier moves each couple along as they book and pay in Square.

sections.label: 3 - DELIVERY DAY AND AFTER
sections.note: Your deliveries in Monday: the balance, the day's list and the photo at the venue, then a thank-you.

nodes.label: 1 - A couple sends an enquiry, and it lands on your Monday consultations board
2 - They get an email right away with a link to book a tasting
3 - They book a tasting in Square, and Zapier adds the date to their Monday item
4 - After the tasting, you add the design, tiers, flavors and servings
5 - They pay the deposit in Square, and Zapier marks them Booked in Monday
6 - No deposit yet? Monday reminds you to follow up with them
7 - Booked cakes move to your deliveries board with the venue and setup time
8 - Before your due date, Monday checks the final balance came in through Square
9 - On the day, your driver sees the delivery list in the Monday app
10 - At the venue, a setup photo goes on the item and it's marked Delivered
11 - After the wedding, the couple gets a thank-you email asking for a review

input_sample.message: We loved your lemon cake at a friend's wedding. Do you do tastings in October?

output_sample.design_details: 3 tiers, vanilla bean / lemon curd / chocolate ganache, pressed florals, serves 120
